# Variable `COMMON_LICENSE_DIR`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Points to `meta/files/common-licenses` in the Source Directory, which is where generic license files reside.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-COMMON_LICENSE_DIR
